proofKindProtocols.extractorTarget: source CCS witness, fold randomness, decomposition witness, and CE-opening witness
proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: independent of legacy micro-round n; fixed-kind fold charges only 16/q^4 + 1/5^81 plus shared terms already deduplicated

runtimeSelectedRepeatedTapeProfile.challengeExpansionMode: domain-separated H_chal expansion from the single external 256-bit CTCO seed through public labels; not seed-bit slicing

proofKindProtocols.fixedKindFiniteLossExpression: selected fold finite term is two PiCCS tapes plus three PiRLC branches: 16/q^4 + 1/5^81; one external CTCO seed remains unchanged

ctcoInteractiveProtocol: P1 sends terminal public commitments, Root_terminal, CtxBind_terminal, and terminal residual/obligation trace commitments

proofKindProtocols.extractorTarget: terminal residual-opening witness, terminal obligation witness, and CE-opening witness
proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: epsilon_qrom_extra_terminal is independent of legacy n_terminal once CTCO preconditions hold; fixed-kind accounting does not flat-sum unrelated proof-kind finite terms
proofKindProtocols.sourceFoldRepeatedTapeProfile: inherits selected-repeated-tape-v1 source fold profile with 2 PiCCS tapes and 3 PiRLC branches when the kind embeds a source fold obligation

ctcoInteractiveProtocol: Verifier first deterministically decompresses to the unique canonical terminal transcript
P1 sends Root_compressed_terminal and CtxBind_compressed_terminal over the canonical decompressed transcript
P2 follows the terminal CTCO response shape; V rejects if compressed bytes do not decompress to the unique transcript before any binding comparison
proofKindProtocols.extractorTarget: same as terminal, after canonical deterministic decompression
proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: epsilon_qrom_extra_compressed_terminal is independent of legacy n_compressed_terminal once CTCO preconditions hold; fixed-kind accounting does not flat-sum unrelated proof-kind finite terms

formalEvidence: canonical compressed encoding decompresses uniquely before verification
interactiveSecurityBound.qromAccountingRule: charged outside epsilon_qrom; decompression ambiguity is charged to canonical-decompression/H_bind bad events

proofKindProtocols.sourceFoldRepeatedTapeProfile: inherits selected-repeated-tape-v1 source fold profile with 2 PiCCS tapes and 3 PiRLC branches when the kind embeds a source fold obligation

proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: epsilon_qrom_extra_numiseal_terminal is independent of legacy n_numiseal_terminal once CTCO preconditions hold; fixed-kind accounting does not flat-sum unrelated proof-kind finite terms

interactiveSecurityBound.qromAccountingRule: charged outside epsilon_qrom; replay/provenance delayed-message ambiguity is charged to binder-target events

proofKindProtocols.sourceFoldRepeatedTapeProfile: inherits selected-repeated-tape-v1 source fold profile with 2 PiCCS tapes and 3 PiRLC branches when the kind embeds a source fold obligation

proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: epsilon_qrom_extra_numiseal_zk_product is independent of legacy n_numiseal_zk_product once CTCO preconditions hold; fixed-kind accounting does not flat-sum unrelated proof-kind finite terms

interactiveSecurityBound.qromAccountingRule: interactive soundness and proof-level simulator coupling are charged outside epsilon_qrom; epsilon_zk_sim is instantiated as zero in the simulator-coupling evidence

proofKindProtocols.sourceFoldRepeatedTapeProfile: inherits selected-repeated-tape-v1 source fold profile with 2 PiCCS tapes and 3 PiRLC branches when the kind embeds a source fold obligation

interactiveSecurityBounds.accountingRule: per-kind interactive soundness is exported to epsilon_fold, epsilon_terminal, epsilon_replay, and epsilon_collision as applicable; proof-level simulator coupling is exported separately to epsilon_zk_sim = 0 by TestVectors/numiseal-zk-simulator-coupling-evidence-v1.json; epsilon_qrom contains only epsilon_compiler_overhead and epsilon_hash_model_gap

transcriptOracleEncodingProof.domainSeparation: versioned first frame, explicit proof kind byte, selected-depth context, CtxBind, Root_k, and challenge tape label

delayedMessageData.acceptanceRule: each delayed theorem-critical object is represented in Move 1 by a 384-bit H_bind target or Root_k commitment; Move 3 may reveal only deterministic responses or local openings that recompute to the Move 1 target

uniqueResponseData.responseRule: for a fixed framed public context, Root_k, rho_k, and verified local openings, verifier-accepted responses are deterministic or quasi-unique modulo declared Root_k/H_bind bad events

proofKinds.responseUniqueness: sumcheck, PiCCS, PiRLC, PiDEC, and CE-opening responses are deterministic from the committed fold trace, rho_fold, and opened local nodes
terminal residual and CE-opening responses are deterministic from Root_terminal, rho_terminal, and opened residual components
canonical decompression is unique before terminal response verification, so response uniqueness reduces to terminal
lane aggregation, scalarization, component-root, replay, provenance, and terminal openings are deterministic from Root_numiseal_terminal and rho_numiseal_terminal
masked residual, mask tensor, randomness-session, and leakage openings are deterministic from Root_numiseal_zk_product and rho_numiseal_zk_product

compilerOverheadInstantiation.modelScope: ideal split-QRO with online extractability assumed by the CTCO theorem contract
compilerOverheadInstantiation.lossSeparation: interactive extractor, proof-level ZK simulator, H_bind collision, replay, constant-time, and release losses are charged outside epsilon_compiler_overhead

qromQueryAndLossInstantiation.queryBoundScope: candidate adversarial quantum random-oracle query cap for selected-depth accounting; not a throughput benchmark and not a production theorem by itself
qromQueryAndLossInstantiation.ctcoSelectedDepthExpression: epsilon_compiler_overhead = 0 in the ideal split-QRO CTCO model and is independent of legacy micro-round count
qromQueryAndLossInstantiation.legacyDFM20SelectedDepthExpression: epsilon_public_coin_transform(depth=1) <= max_kind(((2*Q_H+n_kind+1)^(2*n_kind) / n_kind!) * epsilon_interactive_kind + n_kind! / 2^256 + epsilon_precondition_kind)
